text:
Situation: Ceftazidime is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Inventory varies by site and presentation. Corvale Lakeside has 12 days on hand for the 2 g vial. Corvale General holds 30.7 days for 2 g and 15.8 days for 1 g. Corvale East holds 18.2 days for 2 g and 26.3 days for 1 g.

Why (FDA record): A prior FDA posting for Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, indicates ceftazidime was to be discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-14.

Our position: Supply is adequate at most sites but low at Corvale Lakeside for the 2 g presentation. The rule-based best option is purchasing from Sagent Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Sagent's label does not name a plant that can be placed for sourcing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals to replenish Corvale Lakeside 2 g stock and support other sites as needed.
2. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory at all Corvale sites.
3. Buyer to report supply status to the Pharmacy and Therapeutics committee at the next scheduled meeting.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical substitutions at this time.
